reviewer: implementing-agent review; not independent human or independent model certification
status: posthoc diagnostic audit of exposed v2; not fresh acceptance
unit: exact query plus actual complete top1 passage text; deduplicate identical query+text pairs across pipelines
pass: The presented full passage alone completely answers every requested claim with correct version and scope. Passage language or edition need not match query or designated gold source unless explicitly required by query. Provenance must support applicability; duplicate text alone does not establish edition compatibility.
fail: Presented passage is wrong, inapplicable, or clearly does not answer the requested claim.
uncertain: Partial proof, missing rationale for why, truncated proof, ambiguous version/scope, or applicability cannot be resolved from passage and source provenance. Do not grant extra source context credit.
code: Code is evidence only when it proves the exact requested claim; example of behavior does not alone explain why.
evidence: Every verdict records criterion, rationale, explicit edition/version compatibility, verbatim snippet and Unicode passage/source offsets. Fail/uncertain snippets identify presented material and missing requirement, never invent absent proof.
preflight: Detect every original selected exact quote corpus-wide, record all containing windows and source-edition compatibility explicitly BEFORE reviewing semantic packets. Exact closure is diagnostic, never automatic semantic pass.
blind_packet: Random seeded order, opaque review IDs, exact question, requested version as in question, full original passage and source provenance only. No pipeline/rank/score/gold IDs/acceptance/answerable labels. Mapping retained separately for after review. Previously exposed implementing agent cannot claim cognitively independent blinding.
scoring: Raw top1 lower=pass/all40 answerable, upper=(pass+uncertain)/all40. Frozen-refusal milestone uses accepted pass/all40; abstentions miss. Conditional accepted precision denominator includes all accepted answerable and noanswer requests. Coverage=accepted answerable/40. Noanswer false acceptance=accepted noanswer/12. Also show accepted-answerable precision separately. Never replace historical selected-quote record.
acceptance: 80% stepping/90% higher goal assessed as diagnostic point estimates only, never new certification. Report uncertain bounds; no posthoc rule fitting. Fresh independent acceptance requires new questions and pre-output independent bilingual judgments.
